1. yarn test:app --watch=false: FAIL packages/excalidraw/tests/stickyNotes.test.tsx > sticky notes > editing > routes a top pick to the label and the sticky default while editing a note: AssertionError at stickyNotes.test.tsx:604: expected '#1e1e1e' to be '#e03131' -- after double-clicking a sticky note (text 'hi') and clicking color-top-pick-#e03131, the label's strokeColor (and the note's) must become RED as before this run. When the editor opens, textWysiwyg selects all of its text (editable.select(), textWysiwyg.tsx:1507), so getTextWysiwygSelection() returns start 0, end = originalText.length and actionChangeStrokeColor wrongly takes the range-only branch. Take the range-only branch only for a selection that is non-empty AND does not cover the whole originalText (start > 0 || end < originalText.length); a whole-text selection or a collapsed caret keeps today's whole-element behaviour (element.strokeColor, currentItemStrokeColor and syncStickyNoteInk).
